ترتكسن (form VIII)
# تَرْتَكِسْنَ (tartakisna) /tar.ta.kis.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
# تُرْتَكَسْنَ (turtakasna) /tur.ta.kas.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
